title: The pineapple target during a remote viewing session with McMoneagle

tellings.quote: Yeah. No, I've been with Mc Monagle and experienced it myself where it's like a friend of mine drew like a little spiky thing and it was a pineapple

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that around 2023 or 2024 he sat in on a remote viewing session with Joe McMoneagle, a well-known practitioner. Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe a hidden or distant target using only the mind. Michels says a friend of his drew a little spiky thing, and the hidden target turned out to be a pineapple, which he offers as something he experienced himself.
